_comment: Custom hardware-tint effects added after Pixel-Gray (effect slots 12, 13, 14).
Each look programs the camera's colour processor exactly like the stock Warm/Cool/B&W modes:
u_offset / v_offset : signed chroma shift added to Cb (blue-yellow) / Cr (red-cyan), -128..127
u_gain   / v_gain   : chroma gain in 1/32 steps (32 = unchanged, 0 = monochrome), 0..64
Stock reference values:  Warm = (-20, +20, 5, 20)   Cool = (+20, -20, 20, 5)   B&W = (0, 0, 0, 0)
icon_fg / icon_bg: RGB colours for the 16x16 on-screen icon (the B&W half-circle shape is reused).
